items.title: Ray Bauduc Interview, 1984-06-27
items.q: Herb Wetterman played piano with us at the time

ctx.x: ...25 years ago, Johnny told me about it.

Oh, that, that, that's the guy, uh, Wetterman. Lewinner? Wetter, Wetterman. Uh, uh, Herb Wetterman played piano with us at the time, see? Oh, I see. Because we didn't have a piano when we left Chicago.
